messages.subject: Jake Essex — another date
messages.body:
Hi,

Jake Essex asked me to get in touch. He's already in with you on Saturday
19 December. That night stays as it is. This is a 2027 ask for the Festival
Suite only.

He is the act. No impersonations, no jumpsuit, no corny gimmicks.
Professional solo vocalist from Essex. High-energy 50s and 60s. The night
has a shape: raw 50s through to 70s Vegas, plus Darin, Dion, Holly,
Orbison, Sinatra. Real voice. Own PA, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

A Friday, Saturday, Sunday or function in 2027. Reply here and I'll lock it.

Best,
Natalie
Jake Essex Music
